confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bogota prices for July 2026, not from inspected listings or live booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain; hostel and hotel anchors are less certain. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.9x and 2.7x) because bar and wine prices are weaker recall. Assumes roughly 4,000 COP per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general knowledge of Bogota price levels for restaurants, cafes, bars and registered lodging, compared informally with other mid-cost Latin American capitals.
